children: KiiChain has launched US virtual accounts on Kii. Users can open and manage accounts without a direct banking relationship, send and receive payments through RTP, Fedwire, ACH, and SWIFT, and swap between US dollars and stablecoins. The accounts include FDIC-insured deposits.
The accounts bring traditional banking functions into Kii. Users can manage US dollar finances through established payment networks while keeping access to stablecoin swaps on the same platform.
🇺🇸 US Virtual Accounts are now LIVE on Kii!
• Open and manage US virtual accounts directly from Kii, with no direct banking relationship required.
• Send and receive payments via RTP, Fedwire, ACH, and SWIFT.

title: KiiChain: US virtual accounts go live - 28 Oct 2026
